manual.extreme_winter.page1:
Roof first

Wood, table, tools. Cover center and 7/9 columns. Glass, leaves and caves work.

First hour: prepare. Sleep never speeds winter up.
manual.extreme_winter.page2:
Heat

Campfire: sneak + empty hand to recover. Roof prevents wear.

Stove: furnace + 4 iron + 4 cobble. Range 6; coal 8 min. Hoppers refill. Walls block heat.
manual.extreme_winter.page3:
Wool lining

2 wool + string. Craft armor + lining once.

Full set cuts air loss 35%; leather 15%; lined leather 50%. Water still chills.
manual.extreme_winter.page4:
Portable warmth

3 leather + iron. Fill at water or cauldron. Hold by visible fire/stove, 2 blocks, 10s. Lasts 12 min.

Stew: +10 warmth, air loss -20%, 5 min.
manual.extreme_winter.page5:
Plan travel

First storm at 90 min: 5 min warning, 3 min storm, then relief. Instrument reads plan.

Houses, mines, ships may hold supplies. Pause/offline stop time.
manual.extreme_winter.page6:
Greenhouse

Roof, light 9, heat 0.25. Campfire, lit furnace/stove work. Torches only light.

Outside: half speed at 3h, quarter at 4.5h. Greenhouse/bone meal: normal. No deadlines.
